description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing LoanTermVariations entities within a loan rescheduling domain. It includes custom query methods for retrieving loan term variations based on different criteria such as loan ID, external loan ID, and variation ID, all returning data transfer objects or entity Optionals.

classes.name: LoanTermVariationsRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for performing CRUD and custom queries on LoanTermVariations entities related to loan term adjustments within a loan rescheduling context.

methods.name: findLoanTermVariationsByLoanId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of LoanTermVariationsData objects for a given loan ID, ordered by the applicable term date.

methods.name: findLoanTermVariationsByLoanIdAndTermType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of LoanTermVariationsData filtered by loan ID and term type, ordered by the applicable term date.

methods.name: findLoanTermVariationsByExternalLoanIdAndTermType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of LoanTermVariationsData for an external loan ID and term type, ordered by the applicable term date.

methods.name: findByIdAndLoanIdAndTermType
methods.description: Finds an optional LoanTermVariations entity by variation ID, loan ID, and term type.
